title: Police: No bullying linked to death of Bukidnon student

blocks.text: MARAMAG, Bukidnon — The Maramag Municipal Police Station clarified on Monday that a 10-year-old elementary student who died three weeks ago was not beaten by his classmates, contrary to a local broadcast report. READ: DOJ tasks prosecutors to handle bullying cases Lt. Col. Evary Bacunawa, Maramag police chief, said school-related bullying was not the cause of the child’s death, issuing the clarification after the incident went viral on social media. He cited the death certificate from Bukidnon Provincial Hospital (BPH)-Maramag, which stated that the cause of death was brain bleeding due to a severely low platelet count and pneumonia.
